blockingFindings.title: Completion contract target is missing for failed-recorded advancement
blockingFindings.body:
**Target:** Overview Modules / R6 / src/flow/lib/flow-judgment-contract.js
**Issue:** The spec assigns failed-recorded step completion to src/flow/registry.js, but existing registry completion calls tryUpdateStepStatus(), which invokes assertStepCompletionTransitionAllowed(). That validation is owned by src/flow/lib/flow-judgment-contract.js, whose final-regression policy currently allows only verdicts pass or skipped with failureKind null and nextAction finalize-commit. Changing only the registry post-hook cannot mark a result=fail artifact done.
**Required change:** Add src/flow/lib/flow-judgment-contract.js to the implementation targets and specify the failed-recorded completion contract condition it must allow.
**Why blocking:** Without updating this integration point, the post-hook will still fail when it attempts to set final-regression done for a validated failed-recorded artifact, so the core proceed path cannot work.

blockingFindings.title: Stale artifact rejection has no observable validation basis
blockingFindings.body:
**Target:** R5 / Acceptance Criteria R5
**Issue:** R5 requires --record-and-proceed to reject stale failures, but the spec does not define what stale means for a failed final-regression artifact. Existing stale-proof logic for skipped final-regression uses command identity and changed-file fingerprints, while current fail artifacts only persist command, commandSource, changedFiles, process, and rawOutputPath.
**Required change:** Define the exact stale-check evidence and comparison rule for record-and-proceed, such as current command identity plus current changed-file fingerprints matching durable artifact fields, or another explicit same-run/current-run criterion.
**Why blocking:** Tests cannot design stale-pass and stale-reject cases, and implementation could either accept outdated failure evidence or reject valid evidence arbitrarily.

blockingFindings.title: Out-of-scope and flaky classification criteria are undefined
blockingFindings.body:
**Target:** R1 / R3 / Acceptance Criteria R1-R3
**Issue:** The spec requires user-visible categories out_of_scope and flaky_suspected, but it does not define the evidence source or decision rule for assigning them. Existing final-regression classification only uses command/discovery errors, process output text, timeout/signal/exit status, changed-file references, and classifyRegression change scope; it has no scope-investigation or flake-history input.
**Required change:** Define the smallest classification source and criterion for out_of_scope and flaky_suspected, or remove those categories from required automatic artifact classification and eligibility.
**Why blocking:** Implementation cannot know when to emit these categories, and tests cannot assert category mapping or record-and-proceed eligibility without inventing behavior outside the spec.

blockingFindings.title: Fix-attempt recommendation state has no data path
blockingFindings.target: R4 / R7 / Data Flow: Auto/manual behavior
blockingFindings.body:
**Target:** R4 / R7 / Data Flow: Auto/manual behavior
**Issue:** The spec requires fixAttempts to be preserved and requires record-and-proceed only after a repair attempt still leaves an eligible non-current-diff failure. Existing code can count prior final-regression issue-log failures, but it does not record whether a repair was attempted between failures or which attempts should count for this decision.
**Required change:** Define how fixAttempts is derived and persisted, including what counts as a repair attempt and how the recommendation changes from fix-and-rerun to record-and-proceed.
**Why blocking:** Auto/manual behavior could recommend record-and-proceed after a simple rerun with no repair, or fail to recommend it after a real repair, and there is no observable basis for tests.

nonBlockingImprovements.title: Name the status implementation owner
nonBlockingImprovements.body:
**Target:** Overview Modules / R8
**Improvement:** Mention src/flow/lib/get-status.js explicitly as the status surface that must read and display failed-recorded final-regression evidence.
**Why non-blocking:** R8 already requires status output, so an implementer can infer the target, but naming the file reduces navigation risk.

nonBlockingImprovements.title: Clarify nextAction versus nextRecommendedAction
nonBlockingImprovements.body:
**Target:** R4 / R7 / next-action schema
**Improvement:** State whether nextRecommendedAction is a new field distinct from the retained nextAction field, and list the allowed values such as fix-and-rerun and record-and-proceed.
**Why non-blocking:** The required behavior is understandable, but explicit field/value names would make schema and report tests less interpretive.
